description:
What working residents do: managers, professionals, trades, community and personal service, clerical, sales, machinery operators and labourers, as counts and shares of employed residents for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 8,800 suburbs and localities and 540 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/occupation`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_employed, managers_count, managers_pct, professionals_count, professionals_pct, technicians_and_trades_count, technicians_and_trades_pct, community_and_personal_service_count, community_and_personal_service_pct, clerical_and_administrative_count, clerical_and_administrative_pct, sales_count, sales_pct, machinery_operators_and_drivers_count, machinery_operators_and_drivers_pct, labourers_count, labourers_pct, occupation_not_stated_count, occupation_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
